expected_rate: only when a Day exit is unresolved, a kill-check read fails, an external close is booked, or the journal has a damaged line — rare (about 2 days a month historically), so a quiet session is normal
window_reason: the proof line fires only on a halt cause; historically about 2 such days a month (9/16 account_halted, 10/12 account_invalid)
reversal: a change=halt-1019 block lasting past its booked exit (a marker cleared later than the exit_fill), any booked external_close whose price differs from the Alpaca fills of the orders it names, or a whole-day Day halt written by anything other than the 5% tier kill

metrics.name: Day-tier days with a whole-day latch (_HALT_KEY written)
unresolved markers and their clear time vs the booked exit
metrics.bound: every clear at or after its exit_fill

metrics.name: external-close bookings vs Alpaca fills
metrics.bound: booked price equals the named orders' worst-first average
